invariants.rationale: Result is produced by the execute() method and Option is expected to be non-null (though possibly empty).
The context parameter is directly passed to the executor and should not be null.
indexInstantTime is used to create the ScheduleIndexActionExecutor and is required for scheduling.
partitionsToIndex is required by the action executor and must not be null.
partitionPaths is required by the action executor and must not be null.
